reason: The first bag is free and the fresh things stay mine to choose, so I would try it for the cartons of oil, detergent and diapers I now pay the dekkene extra for. If the slip really shows I saved something, I keep going, but not for every little thing.
objection: I buy a little every day, not twice a week with a list the night before. And I do not know this neighbour, so I want to see that the slip is honest and the total matches what I pay.
would_change_my_mind: Someone from my own village or parish who already uses it tells me the slips and prices were right.
